reportContract.rule: Always expose every mandatory section. Empty sections must be shown as NONE or DATA_GAP; never silently omit them. Discovery wallets promoted to Tier A must expose live-surveillance state. WHALES DEEP 6h/24h/72h, net accumulation and CEX flows must be persisted and exposed when available. Unsupported claims must remain DATA_GAP.

health.solanaOperationalMeaning: All enabled multichain monitors passed, including resilient Solana RPC.

source.interpretation: Wallets come from a first-20-buyer alpha dataset; this is an early-entry universe, not a generic rich-wallet leaderboard.

methodology.purpose: Find wallets with repeatable positive results as early buyers before later token expansion.

promotionPolicy.purpose: Promote statistically profitable early-buyer wallets into persistent surveillance. Promotion is surveillance only, never automatic execution.

limitations: The MadeOnSol alpha leaderboard is Solana/Pump.fun early-buyer intelligence, not a universal multichain ranking.
Leaderboard performance is historical and does not guarantee future edge.
The public demo source is delayed and rate-limited; production-grade sub-minute discovery requires a dedicated API key/provider.
Unknown alpha wallets are not assumed to be independent humans merely because exclude_bots=true; insider/sybil risk remains a separate validation layer.

explicitDataGaps: No automatic EVM/Base/Arbitrum discovery in V1; current discovery engine is Solana first-20-buyer focused.
No automatic insider/deployer-link graph yet beyond provider bot filtering.
No guaranteed token-level live trade stream for newly discovered non-KOL wallets using the public demo tier.
Historical alpha score is a surveillance ranking, not a BUY signal.

results.interpretation: Known-wallet BUY/SELL signals are reconstructed from the tracked-wallet transaction set. Contract resolution uses CoinGecko's static chain token list first, validates the symbol on-chain, then falls back to DexScreener and the CoinGecko API. Token-centric net transfer flows are contextual evidence only and are not automatically classified as buys or whale accumulation.

deepValidation.interpretation: WHALES DEEP runs 6h/24h/72h validation. Two highest-priority qualifying names are continuously reserved; remaining DEEP slots rotate every scheduled interval through the queue. Token transfer flows remain contextual and are never automatically relabeled as buys or accumulation.

largeTransfers.reason: Raw token flows can include swaps, transfers, airdrops or dust. They are not promoted to large BUY/SELL transfer signals without transaction-level classification and sizing thresholds.

netAccumulation.methodology: Persistent deduplicated ledger of confirmed BUY/SELL classifications only. Raw TOKEN_FLOW is excluded from accumulation math.

cexFlows.interpretation: Exchange labels are attribution evidence, not proof that the asset was sold or bought. Deposits/withdrawals are pressure/context signals only.

smartMoneyExternal.reason: WHALES Discovery scores on-chain early buyers, but no independent external smart-money labeling/consensus provider is persisted in the WHALES report yet.

enhancements.rule: TOKEN_FLOW_CONTEXT_ONLY is never promoted to BUY/SELL without trade-level evidence. Net accumulation uses confirmed classifications only. CEX labels are context signals and never proof of sale/purchase.
